goal: Verify that a query flows through the entire pipeline: Retrieval → Reranker → Generation → streamed SSE response with citations.
preconditions_global: Phase 2 completed — you have an indexed project with documents (status 'indexed' in Mongo)
docker compose up -d — services: retrieval (8004), reranker (8005), generation (8006), orchestrator (8002), query-processor (8003) are running
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in .env (or LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter with OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

variables_legend.$ADMIN_TOKEN: Admin JWT token — from POST http://localhost:8000/auth/login
variables_legend.$PROJECT_ID: Project ID with indexed documents — MongoDB ObjectId string
variables_legend.$CONVERSATION_ID: Conversation ID — from the conversation_id field in /chat/query response

scenarios.title: Health check — all query pipeline services
scenarios.description: Verify that retrieval, reranker, generation, orchestrator and query-processor respond on /health.

steps.command: curl -s http://localhost:8004/health
steps.postman_command: curl --location 'http://localhost:8004/health'

steps.command: curl -s http://localhost:8005/health
steps.postman_command: curl --location 'http://localhost:8005/health'

steps.command: curl -s http://localhost:8006/health
steps.postman_command: curl --location 'http://localhost:8006/health'

steps.command: curl -s http://localhost:8002/health
steps.postman_command: curl --location 'http://localhost:8002/health'

steps.command: curl -s http://localhost:8003/health
steps.postman_command: curl --location 'http://localhost:8003/health'

scenarios.title: Retrieval — basic hybrid search
scenarios.description: Retrieval service performs hybrid search (BM25 + vector) and returns top-k chunks with metadata from Mongo (filename, page). Called directly to the service, bypassing the gateway.

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8004/retrieve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 5, "alpha": 0.5}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8004/retrieve' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 5, "alpha": 0.5}'
steps.notes: filename and page fields should be populated from Mongo (enrichment from chunks + documents collections)

scenarios.title: Retrieval — BM25 only (alpha=0.0) vs vector only (alpha=1.0)
scenarios.description: The alpha parameter controls the weight of BM25 (0.0) vs vector (1.0) in Weaviate hybrid search. Chunk ranking may differ for the same queries.

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8004/retrieve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "warfarin bleeding risk", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 3, "alpha": 0.0}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8004/retrieve' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "warfarin bleeding risk", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 3, "alpha": 0.0}'
steps.notes: Ranking based purely on BM25 — results based on keyword matching

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8004/retrieve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "warfarin bleeding risk", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 3, "alpha": 1.0}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8004/retrieve' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "warfarin bleeding risk", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 3, "alpha": 1.0}'
steps.notes: Ranking based purely on vector similarity — results semantically related even without exact keywords

steps.action: Compare chunk_id and score in both results
steps.notes: Ranking may differ — this is expected behaviour. At alpha=0.5 (default) Weaviate uses RELATIVE_SCORE fusion.

scenarios.title: Reranker — cross-encoder reranks retrieval results
scenarios.description: BGE-reranker-v2-m3 takes a query + list of chunks and returns them sorted descending by cross-encoder score. Model is loaded on first call (may be slow).

steps.action: Fetch chunks from retrieval (top_k=10) — save the chunks[] field for step 2
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8004/retrieve -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 10, "alpha": 0.5}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8004/retrieve' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "top_k": 10, "alpha": 0.5}'
steps.notes: Copy the chunks[] array from the response — needed in step 2

steps.action: Rerank top-3 — replace [...] with the actual chunks[] array from step 1
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8005/rerank -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "chunks": [...], "top_n": 3}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8005/rerank' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "drug interaction warfarin aspirin", "chunks": [...], "top_n": 3}'
steps.notes: Cross-encoder score (logit) is unscaled — ordering matters, not the absolute value. First call loads the ~500MB model from HuggingFace.

scenarios.title: Query Processor — HyDE (hypothetical document generation)
scenarios.description: POST /hyde takes a query and returns a hypothetical_document — a 2-3 sentence fragment that the LLM generated as a hypothetical answer. This text is then concatenated with the query and sent to retrieval in HydePipeline.

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8003/hyde -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "Can aspirin and warfarin be taken together?"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8003/hyde' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "Can aspirin and warfarin be taken together?"}'

expected_response_shape.query: Can aspirin and warfarin be taken together?
expected_response_shape.hypothetical_document: <2-3 medical sentences about the aspirin-warfarin interaction>

steps.notes: Requires LLM API key. The generated document should contain medical terminology matching the indexed documents.

scenarios.title: Query Processor — query rewriting
scenarios.description: POST /rewrite rewrites the user query into a more precise one with medical terminology. Optionally accepts context (conversation history).

steps.action: Rewrite a simple query without context
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8003/rewrite -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "can I mix these two pills", "context": ""}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8003/rewrite' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "can I mix these two pills", "context": ""}'

expected_response_shape.original_query: can I mix these two pills

steps.action: Rewrite a query with conversation context
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8003/rewrite -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "what about the dosage?", "context": "User asked about warfarin and aspirin interaction."}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8003/rewrite' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "what about the dosage?", "context": "User asked about warfarin and aspirin interaction."}'
steps.notes: Context should influence the rewrite — the query should be expanded with the context topic (warfarin, aspirin)

scenarios.title: Generation — non-streaming response
scenarios.description: POST /generate takes a query + list of chunks and returns a full LLM answer with extracted [SOURCE_N] citations.

steps.action: Generate a response with sample chunks
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "test-1", "content": "Aspirin inhibits COX enzymes and platelet aggregation. Combined with warfarin, it significantly increases bleeding risk.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "doc-1", "filename": "drug_interactions.pdf", "page": 12}], "conversation_history": []}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/generate' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "test-1", "content": "Aspirin inhibits COX enzymes and platelet aggregation. Combined with warfarin, it significantly increases bleeding risk.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "doc-1", "filename": "drug_interactions.pdf", "page": 12}], "conversation_history": []}'
steps.notes: Answer should contain [SOURCE_1] inline. Citations are extracted from the LLM response via regex.

scenarios.title: Generation — SSE streaming response
scenarios.description: POST /generate/stream streams the response token by token as Server-Sent Events. The last event type='citations' contains the citation list, followed by [DONE].

steps.action: Stream response — observe tokens and final citations
steps.command: curl -s -N -X POST http://localhost:8006/generate/stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d $'{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "test-1", "content": "Aspirin inhibits COX enzymes. Combined with warfarin, it increases bleeding risk significantly.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "doc-1", "filename": "drug_interactions.pdf", "page": 12}], "conversation_history": []}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/generate/stream' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "test-1", "content": "Aspirin inhibits COX enzymes. Combined with warfarin, it increases bleeding risk significantly.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "doc-1", "filename": "drug_interactions.pdf", "page": 12}], "conversation_history": []}'
steps.notes: curl -N disables buffering. In Postman: Send → observe Body live (SSE).

scenarios.title: Orchestrator — vanilla pipeline E2E through gateway
scenarios.description: Full query through gateway: POST /chat/query → orchestrator fetches project settings (rag_mode=vanilla) → retrieval → reranker → generation → response with citations and conversation_id.

steps.action: Set rag_mode=vanilla for the project (if not already default)
steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "vanilla", "hybrid_alpha": 0.5, "top_k": 10, "rerank_top_n": 3}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "vanilla", "hybrid_alpha": 0.5, "top_k": 10, "rerank_top_n": 3}'
steps.notes: Admin endpoint — requires admin role in JWT token

steps.action: Send query through gateway — vanilla mode
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'

steps.notes: Needed for scenario 3.10 (verify save in Mongo)

scenarios.title: Orchestrator — conversation saved in MongoDB
scenarios.description: After a query, the orchestrator saves the conversation in the 'conversations' collection. Verify directly in Mongo that messages contains {role: user} and {role: assistant}.

steps.action: Send a second query in the same conversation
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the recommended monitoring?", "conversation_id": "$CONVERSATION_ID", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the recommended monitoring?", "conversation_id": "$CONVERSATION_ID", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: conversation_id from the previous query — response should have the same conversation_id

steps.command: docker exec medrag-mongo-1 mongosh medrag --eval 'db.conversations.findOne({_id: ObjectId("$CONVERSATION_ID")}, {messages: 1, rag_mode: 1})' --quiet
steps.notes: Orchestrator stores the last 10 messages in the conversation history (window)

scenarios.title: Orchestrator — HyDE pipeline E2E
scenarios.description: Same query as in 3.9 but with rag_mode=hyde in project settings. Pipeline uses Query Processor (/hyde) to generate a hypothetical document before retrieval.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "hyde"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "hyde"}'

steps.action: Send the same query — HyDE pipeline
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Field rag_mode='hyde'. HydePipeline calls /hyde → concatenates result with query → then retrieval. May return different citations than vanilla.

scenarios.title: Citations — response contains source references
scenarios.description: Citations are extracted from the LLM response via regex [SOURCE_N] and mapped to chunk metadata. Verify that snippet and filename are populated.

steps.action: Send query and verify citation structure
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "List drug interactions with warfarin", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "List drug interactions with warfarin", "stream": false}'
checks: citations is not an empty list (LLM used at least one [SOURCE_N])
snippet is max ~200 chars and ends with '…' if truncated
filename populated if the document had a filename
steps.notes: If citations is empty — LLM did not use any [SOURCE_N] inline. Check the answer field for [SOURCE_1] etc. May require adjusting the system prompt.

scenarios.title: Orchestrator — streaming E2E through gateway (SSE)
scenarios.description: POST /chat/query/stream through gateway — response is an SSE stream with tokens and final citations. Gateway detects Accept: text/event-stream and forwards the stream instead of buffering the full response.

steps.command: curl -s -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the mechanism of warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the mechanism of warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.notes: Endpoint /chat/query/stream (not /chat/query). Gateway forwards SSE transparently via httpx StreamingResponse. curl -N disables buffering — you should see tokens in real time.
